title: Roofing Contractor in McAllen, TX | Edel Roofing & Construction
description: Roofing contractor for McAllen, TX homes and businesses: replacement, repairs and commercial roofs. Rated 4.8 on Google. Free estimate: (956) 422-3335.
lede: Edel Roofing & Construction replaces and repairs roofs on McAllen homes and does commercial roofing for McAllen businesses. We're licensed, bonded and insured, and your estimate is free.

sections.title: Roofing services in McAllen
paras: We're based in Edinburg and have roofed across Hidalgo County since 2003. McAllen is a big part of our week. We replace roofs in north McAllen neighborhoods, work on commercial flat roofs along Nolana and 10th Street, and fix leaks all over the city.

McAllen is one of the fastest growing cities in Texas. So you have plenty of roofs getting close to the end of their first life, and plenty of new houses going up next to them. We work on both. If you just want to know how your roof is doing, ask for a free inspection and we'll get out there soon.

sections.title: Roofing services we offer in McAllen

cards.title: Residential Roof Replacement
cards.body: We tear off the old roof and put on a new one. Shingles come from CertainTeed, Owens Corning or GAF. You get a written estimate, we check the decking once the old roof is off, and we clean up the yard before we leave.

cards.title: Roof Repairs
cards.body: Leaks, shingles the wind blew off, bad flashing and skylight problems. We track down where the trouble starts instead of patching only what you can see. Most repairs are done in one visit.

cards.title: Commercial Roofing
cards.body: Flat and low slope roofs for McAllen businesses and strip centers. We install TPO, EPDM and modified bitumen, and we fix leaks on flat roofs that are already up.

cards.title: Storm & Hail Damage
cards.body: A bad Hidalgo County storm can do a lot of damage. We look for hail hits, wind uplift and lost granules, and we put what we find in writing. You can hand that report to your insurance company.

cards.title: Roof Inspections
cards.body: We walk the roof, write down what we find, and tell you straight how it's doing. Good to have before you buy a house, after a storm, or when something on the roof just doesn't look right.

cards.title: Roof Coatings
cards.body: A reflective coat over a commercial or flat roof you already have. It extends the roof's life and keeps some heat off the building. It costs less than replacing a roof that's still in good shape underneath.

sections.title: What roofing problems are most common in McAllen?
paras: A big city that grew fast ends up with every kind of roof, and McAllen has them. In the older neighborhoods around 2nd Street and 10th Street, many homes still have shingle roofs from the 1980s and 90s, and those are due for replacement. In north McAllen, around Sharyland and Las Cumbres, the homes are newer, so we do more storm repairs there than full replacements.

For businesses, the strip centers along Nolana Ave, the medical buildings near South Texas Health System, and the warehouses and industrial buildings in north McAllen all have flat or low slope roofs. If one of those starts leaking while you're open, it's a real problem. We can usually get you an inspection soon.

Valley weather is hard on a roof. The heat wears out shingles and membranes faster, and the sun breaks the materials down quicker than up north. When hail hits McAllen, some roofs only lose looks and others get real damage. After any big storm, it's worth having someone look.

faqs.q: Does Edel Roofing serve McAllen, TX?
faqs.a: Yes, all the time, for home roof replacements, repairs and commercial roofs. Our shop is in Edinburg, about 15 minutes from central McAllen. Call or book online and we'll set up a free inspection.

faqs.q: My business in McAllen has a flat roof leak. Can you fix it?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair flat and low slope commercial roofs in McAllen. A flat roof leak is often harder to trace than one on a house, because the water travels before it shows up inside. We take the time to find where it really gets in. Call (956) 422-3335 to set up an inspection.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost in McAllen?
faqs.a: For a typical McAllen home, a full shingle replacement usually runs between $8,000 and $18,000. Roof size, pitch, what's on the roof now and the shingle you pick all change the number. You get a written estimate before any work, with no obligation. Call us or book an inspection online to get the real number for your roof.

faqs.q: Do you handle insurance claims for storm or hail damage in McAllen?
faqs.a: We inspect the damage and give you a written report of what we find, which helps when you file your claim. We are not a public adjuster. We'll go over what we saw so you know what to show your insurance company. We've done this for homeowners and property managers across McAllen after big hailstorms.

faqs.q: How do I get a roofing estimate in McAllen?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book online at the link above. We pick a time, inspect and measure your roof, and give you a written estimate. It's free, and you don't owe us anything if you decide not to go ahead.
